N1.s: Visas %lld bezmaksas vietas ir aizņemtas. Atbloķējiet Cutling lietotnē, un šis Cutling tiks saglabāts.
N1.back: All 5 free places are taken. Unlock(you-polite) Cutling in-the-app, and this Cutling will-be saved.
N1.why: Opens with S3's own sentence; "lietotnē" says the unlocking happens in the app the prompt's button continues to, and "šis Cutling" can only mean the item, since the app cannot be "this".

N2.s: Visas %lld bezmaksas vietas ir aizņemtas. Atveriet Cutling, lai atbloķētu vairāk vietas.
N2.back: All 5 free places are taken. Open(you-polite) Cutling, in-order-to unlock more room.
N2.why: Here nothing can continue in the app, so the instruction is to open it; "vairāk vietas" (more room, genitive singular) carries "save more" in two words and keeps the line under 90.

N3.why: "Saglabāts" is masculine to agree with Cutling, as in S23; "palika viena vieta" is how Latvians say only one seat is left, and like K1 the capsule drops "bezmaksas" to fit.

N4.why: The participle agrees with the places named on the capsule before, and "aizņemtas … no" is S21's wording, so 5 of 5 reads as full without the word itself.

N5.why: Starts like N4 so the bar follows on from the last capsule; the infinitives name what a tap does, as K1's "Atbloķēt" does, and "un saglabāt" says the waiting item gets saved.

N6.why: The infinitive Latvian buttons take, and the same word as S15, so the Share sheet and the unlock sheet name the action alike.

N7.s: Visas %lld bezmaksas vietas ir aizņemtas. Atbloķējiet Cutling, un šis tiks saglabāts.
N7.back: All 5 free places are taken. Unlock(you-polite) Cutling, and this will-be saved.
N7.why: An imperative then "un" plus the future is how Latvian says do this and that follows; "šis" alone points at the item shown in the form under the notice, in the masculine of Cutling.

N8.s: Šis ir atlikts malā un tiks saglabāts, kad atvērsiet un atbloķēsiet Cutling.
N8.back: This is put aside and will-be saved, when you-will-open and you-will-unlock Cutling.
N8.why: "atlikts malā" is set aside and kept for you, so it never claims the item is saved yet; the future "kad atvērsiet" puts opening and unlocking as the next step, not a demand.
